story:
[emotion:QT/happy] Olivia ran across the wide, green park, holding a bright red kite above her head. The kite was beautiful — tall, shiny, and fast.

[emotion:QT/sad] Suddenly, the string snapped. The kite fell behind a tall bush.

[emotion:QT/afraid] Olivia felt worried. She couldn't reach it alone.

A girl named Mia walked over. "I can help," Mia said gently. "I'm good at climbing over things."

Together, they crawled carefully around the bush and caught the kite.

[gesture:clapping] [emotion:QT/happy] "We did it!" Olivia said, feeling grateful. [emotion:QT/happy] Mia smiled proudly.

[emotion:QT/happy] Because they worked together, the kite flew high again — and Olivia found a wonderful new friend.
